description: This file contains the entry point for the Spring Boot application. It initializes the application with custom property settings to enforce server binding to a specific address and port, based on environment variables or defaults, and disables command-line property injection.

classes.name: PlatformApplication
classes.description: Main application class annotated to indicate a Spring Boot application, contains the main method that configures and runs the application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that sets default server address and port, and starts the Spring Boot application with specific properties.
